Video Games:

10) Animal Crossing: New Horizons

This game’s popularity has boosted over the Pandemic, where players can enjoy building a utopian town from scratch on a deserted island.



9) Roblox

This online sandbox has user-created games that anybody can play on their devices such as tycoons, simulators, stories and more. Anybody can make a game or play one, and that has been a huge hit with mostly younger children.



8) Among Us

This hit game has risen through the ranks as a social skills game where you must figure out the imposter on your ship before they eradicate everybody.



7) Rocket League

This fantastic fusion of fast cars and soccer has scored with many players (no pun intended). Users love the fast-paced action of this game and the competition has many hooked.



6) Spider Man

This comic book hero turned video game character has grown in popularity. As a user, you must play as Peter Parker or Spider Man, and defeat various villains trying to terrorize your city. This game has a linear plotline, but is popular for its smooth graphics and gameplay.



5) Grand Theft Auto 5

This game has become infamous for its adult content, but this version is better than the rest. As another open-world game, you must navigate your criminal avatar through the Los-Angeles-inspired city to complete missions, and eventually win the game.



4) Red Dead Redemption 2

This game has shot up to number four in the video game world**** for its smooth graphics and gripping plot. Gamers also love the avatar, Arthur Morgan for his complicated past and future.



3) Fortnite

Fortnite has been a game changer in the video game industry, with approximately 500 million players on the server. It is most popular for its Battle Royale, where players or teams must fight each other to be the last one standing.



2) Super Smash Bros: Ultimate

As the largest compilation of Nintendo characters, it has become one of the most popular video games played right now. Users love the smooth graphics and one of its most popular features, the multiplayer which allows up to 6 people to play at a time.



And the #1 Most played Video game right now is…

MINECRAFT!
author: Marshall Friedman
